Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly treated the artist’s “Origin” (Paris, France) on Wikipedia as the birthplace and decided to use it as such. “Origin” is not the same as birthplace; the correct birthplace for Nekfeu (performer of Égérie) is La Trinité (Alpes-Maritimes), France. This conflation could directly lead to the wrong answer.
